result.title: ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS)
result.summary: Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59% and closes 46.05% of the average rank gap between the single best solver (SBS) and the virtual best solver (VBS).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ST-GNN-AAAS，用时空图神经网络为 TSP 的 anytime 求解器选择建模：将当前巡回路径编码为时变节点特征，结合短窗口内的求解器表现历史，预测较长未来时间跨度上的求解器选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用短历史执行轨迹预测更长时域收益并据此分配计算」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中动态计算预算分配与停止决策的设计，但对象是组合优化求解器而非视觉推理，迁移属推测。
